issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to a class named Meal (including UML and examples), but the template repository provides an Order class and an empty Meal.java file. This identifier mismatch (Meal vs Order) will confuse students about which class to implement/use and whether to modify Order or create Meal. The Main comments in the template also reference Order, whereas the solution and problem use Meal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make naming consistent across artifacts. Either (A) provide a fully implemented Meal.java in the template (or rename Order.java to Meal.java and ensure its API matches the problem statement), and update Main comments to use Meal; or (B) update the problem statement and solution to consistently use Order instead of Meal. Preferred fix: add/replace the template's Meal class (with name and ingredients fields and getters) so it matches the problem description and the solution.
